home.headline: Any corner, redone.
home.intro: Scan a whole room, a corner or a balcony. See three ways it could look, built from real products that fit.
home.worksWith: Works with whole rooms, corners and balconies

capture.title: Mapping your space
capture.guideTitle: Cover what you want to change
capture.guideBody: A whole room, one corner or the balcony. Tap Done once it's all in.

light.title: A little more light
light.body: Switch on a lamp or open the curtains, then move slowly. We keep everything mapped so far.

motion.title: A little slower
motion.body: Pan slowly and hold the phone steady. We keep everything mapped so far.

glare.title: Too much glare
glare.body: Point away from mirrors, windows and bare bulbs, or change your angle. We keep everything mapped so far.

capture.permissionBody: The camera is used only to scan the space you want redone.
capture.noCamera: No camera was found on this phone. You can use photos instead.

space.redoPartBody: Draw around a corner or wall
space.verifyBody: Measure one wall with a tape. It snaps in and re-fits the whole space.

rooms.title: My rooms
rooms.emptyBody: Rooms you scan and designs you save will appear here.

vastu.title: Vastu
vastu.label: Vastu guidance, as close as possible. For a full consultation, speak to an expert.
vastu.body: Scan a room to see its direction and a room scorecard.

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestTitle: You are browsing as a guest
profile.guestBody: Explore freely. We ask you to sign in only when you are ready to design a room.
